summary: Chunk 115-151 is sound overall: no invented content, identifications (apasmāra, aśmarī, godhā, varāha, prameha, raktapitta, śoṣa, ānāha, udāvarta, jarāyu, nāḍī=umbilical cord) are correctly tagged and hedged. Real faults: unit 144 words attached to the wrong tokens (ca under bhavaṃti), 137 upācaretām labelled mid. (it is parasmaipada). Minor: gender 'm./n.' against glossary rule on unstated nouns (117-134), copy-pasted nityā note in six units, madhurā- unflagged anomaly (129), Hindi vāyu/वात, 'अत्यधिक' in 125, missing 'और' in 150, 'begets' vs 'produces', Hindi gloss for raktāvasecana. Unpatched observations: 122 'stenā tu' conjectural split behind 'however'; 127 krathana (possibly krodhana); 144 'these'; 117-134 fragments. Text flags 116,119,120,135,139,141,143 judged plausible (116 nāḍīṃ, 119 ahrīka, 143 stray d are 'possible'; 120 and 139 near certain). Hedges and src handling OK; confidence levels honest. Counts: 2 errors, 40 minor.
glossary_suggestions: janayati carried over 117-134 is rendered 'produces' / उत्पन्न करती है in every unit (also 135).
Avagraha printed after -ā (ऽ in kalahaśīlā'pasmāriṇaṃ, nityā'śmariṇaṃ, āsevamānāṃ'tarvatnī) is a print habit; normalise, record once.
upācaretām is parasmaipada (3 du. opt.); 'mid.' only for -eyātām etc.
Taste compounds in the -nityā lists use the bare stem (madhura-nityā); long ā in madhurā- is a print slip (possible).
Hindi names the doṣa as वात even in explanatory glosses (udāvarta); वायु only for plain wind.
Unstated-noun adjectives: gram gives case and number only, never 'm./n.'.
